obligations.expected_behavior: When FR-10 enable applies to an approved candidate, execute a real Candidate call.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated no-call-fixture fixture records a real Candidate call while all other inputs remain constant.
obligations.state_after: The approved candidate has undergone a real Candidate call.
obligations.state_before: An approved candidate is present and FR-10 enable is under test.
obligations.subject: FR-10 enable
obligations.trigger: An approved candidate is evaluated with FR-10 enabled.

obligations.expected_behavior: When FR-10 disable applies to an enabled candidate, execute a real Prior call.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated config-only-fixture fixture records a real Prior call while all other inputs remain constant.
obligations.state_after: The candidate has undergone a real Prior call.
obligations.state_before: The candidate is enabled and FR-10 disable is under test.
obligations.subject: FR-10 disable
obligations.trigger: A candidate is evaluated with FR-10 disabled.

obligations.expected_behavior: When rollback is applicable, restore the Prior identity, verdict, and category.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated rejection-only-fixture fixture verifies restoration of the Prior identity, verdict, and category while all other inputs remain constant.
obligations.state_after: The Prior identity, verdict, and category are restored.
obligations.subject: FR-10 rollback

obligations.expected_behavior: When the candidate is current and FR-10 is re-enabled, execute a real Candidate call.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated skip-fixture fixture records a real Candidate call while all other inputs remain constant.
obligations.state_after: The current candidate has undergone a real Candidate call after re-enable.
obligations.state_before: The candidate is current and FR-10 re-enable is under test.
obligations.subject: FR-10 re-enable
obligations.trigger: A current candidate is evaluated after FR-10 is re-enabled.
